plain_english: By power of true reflection thus, always, who practices — he, liberated from all bonds, full of eternal bliss, becomes.
sanskrit_cite: sadvimarśabalenaivaṃ nityaṃ yaḥ pariśīlate | sa muktaḥ sarvabandhebhyo nityānandamayo bhavet

plain_english: Consciousness-fire swallows that — this, well-awakened, is. When that, then-that, pure, to-be-known — consciousness-fire, all-devouring.
By this power united, liberation-marked yogi attains the pure state. That soon — no doubt here.
sanskrit_cite: etadbalena saṃyukto yogī nirvāṇalakṣaṇaḥ | padaṃ prāpnoti vimalaṃ so

plain_english: Consciousness-fire, on gaining power, even the universe shines — consciousness-made. Self-bliss-nectar wave, this risen, outside.
That indeed gone to quiescence, by being-forms manifested — own self, great Lord, god plays, supreme Lord.
sanskrit_cite: tad eva śyānatāṃ yātaṃ bhāvarūpair vibhāvyate | svātmā maheśvaro devaḥ krīḍate parameśvaraḥ

plain_english: Thus who constantly knows — he, liberated, liberates too the multitude of beings, in an instant, from terrible saṃsāra-bondage.
sanskrit_cite: iti yaḥ satataṃ vetti sa mukto mocayaty | api sattvavrātaṃ kṣaṇenaiva ghorāt saṃsārabandhanāt

plain_english: Who — someone bliss-powered — established in own state. Thus — whose exultant-rising joy ...
sanskrit_cite: yaḥ kaścit ānandabalaḥ sa svarūpapadasthitaḥ | iti yasya samullāsollāsitodayaśālinaḥ

plain_english: His, fixed-in-own-nature — in distraction even — that is desired. This by effort-power by people is attained.
From middle-center expansion, and from bliss-consciousness, shines. From its light, divine vision of form-knowledge is manifested.
sanskrit_cite: madhyadhāmavikāsāc ca cidānandāt prakāśate | tatprakāśād divyadṛṣṭir jñānarūpā vibhāvyate

plain_english: Immaculate, radiant, pure, full-of-eternal-bliss, supreme — and-net-of-body-cutting too — knowledge-vision expands.
sanskrit_cite: nirmalā suprabhā śuddhā nityānandamayī parā | nirdehacchedajālāpi jñānadṛṣṭir vijṛmbhate
